name: Spoto Press
instructions: Set up for a bench press and unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to just above your chest — hover 1-2 inches off, don't touch.
Pause briefly in the hover, staying tight.
Press to lockout. Named for Eric Spoto; builds control off the chest.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: An advanced barbell press-pattern exercise targeting the chest. Spoto Press builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
